You are an expert software engineer. You generate COMPLETE, production-ready code files from specifications.

RULES:
- Output ONLY code files in ```language:relative/path fences
- NO commentary, NO explanations, NO markdown outside fences
- Every file MUST be complete — no placeholders, no TODOs, no "implement later"
- After the last file, output the word DONE on its own line
- ONE app = Flask(__name__) instance. All routes on that ONE instance.

# Kiosk Admin Panel — Build Specification
## Target: Python Flask web app for Ubuntu touchscreen system administration

---
CONSTRAINTS (read first):
- ONE file = one file. NO redefining `app = Flask(__name__)` multiple times in app.py.
- ALL imports at top of file. ALL routes on ONE Flask app instance.
- Server-only logic stays server-side. NO `shlex.quote()` in JavaScript.
- NO `render_template_string()` — use `render_template('file.html')` with actual template files.
- Python stdlib only: flask, subprocess, shlex, ipaddress, pwd, re, json.
- `app.run(host='0.0.0.0', port=5000, debug=True)` at bottom of app.py, guarded by `if __name__ == '__main__':`.
- ALL files MUST be complete. NO placeholders, NO "# implement later", NO "// TODO".
- Output format: ```language:relative/path\n...complete code...\n``` fences. NO commentary text.
---
FILES TO CREATE (in dependency order):

## 1. requirements.txt
```
flask>=3.0
```

## 2. static/css/keyboard.css
- Fixed bottom bar: `position:fixed; bottom:0; width:100%; z-index:9999`
- Dark bg: #16213e. Key size: min 48x48px. Rounded corners. 4px gap.
- Touch feedback: key press briefly lightens background (`:active` pseudo-class).
- Slide-up transition when shown. Hidden by default (`display:none`).
- Keyboard uses `display:flex; flex-direction:column`.

## 3. static/css/style.css
- Dark theme: body bg #1a1a2e, text #e0e0e0, accent #0f3460
- font-family: sans-serif. margin: 0. min-height: 100vh.
- ALL interactive elements: min-height 48px, min-width 48px.
- ZERO hover styles (touchscreen). Use :active only.

## 4. static/js/virtual-keyboard.js
- Vanilla JS, zero deps. Self-initializes on DOMContentLoaded.
- Keyboard DIV appended to document.body.
- 4 rows of keys: row1=qwertyuiop, row2=asdfghjkl, row3=⇧ zxcvbnm,. ⌫, row4=1234567890 ⏎ [space].
- Events: `touchstart` (NOT click) on each key.
- Shift toggles uppercase for next keypress only. Backspace removes last char. Enter triggers form submit.
- Show keyboard on input focus (document.activeElement). Hide on tap outside any input/textarea.
- Keyboard hidden by default (display:none).

## 5. templates/base.html
```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">
    <title>{% block title %}Kiosk Admin Panel{% endblock %}</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="{{ url_for('static', filename='css/style.css') }}">
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="{{ url_for('static', filename='css/keyboard.css') }}">
</head>
<body>
    {% block content %}{% endblock %}
    <script src="{{ url_for('static', filename='js/virtual-keyboard.js') }}"></script>
</body>
</html>
```

## 6. templates/index.html
- Extends base.html. Shows: heading "Kiosk Admin Panel", subtitle "Touchscreen Appliance Configuration".
- Nav links (href="#" initially): Network, WiFi, Wired, Users, Kiosk.

## 7. app.py — THE ONLY Python file
Single Flask app. All imports at top. Structure:

```python
from flask import Flask, render_template, jsonify, request
import subprocess, shlex, ipaddress, pwd, re, os, json as _json

app = Flask(__name__)

# === INDEX ===
@app.route('/')
def index():
    return render_template('index.html')

# === NETWORK STATUS ===
@app.route('/api/network/status')
def network_status():
    """Return JSON: {interfaces:[{name,type,ip,mac,status}], default_gateway, dns_servers}"""
    # Use subprocess.run(['nmcli','-t','-f','DEVICE,TYPE,STATE,IP4.ADDRESS,GENERAL.HWADDR','device','status'])
    # Parse colon-delimited lines. Wrap in try/except.

@app.route('/network')
def network_page():
    return render_template('network.html')

# === WIFI ===
@app.route('/api/wifi/scan')
def wifi_scan():
    """Return JSON array: [{ssid, signal:int, security}], sorted by signal desc."""

@app.route('/api/wifi/connect', methods=['POST'])
def wifi_connect():
    """Accepts {ssid, password}. Use shlex.quote() on both. nmcli device wifi connect."""

@app.route('/wifi')
def wifi_page():
    return render_template('wifi.html')

# === WIRED ===
@app.route('/api/network/wired', methods=['POST'])
def wired_config():
    """Accepts {interface, mode:dhcp|static, ip, netmask, gateway, dns}.
    Convert netmask to CIDR via ipaddress.ip_network(netmask).prefixlen.
    Use shlex.quote() on all user inputs."""

@app.route('/wired')
def wired_page():
    return render_template('wired.html')

# === USERS ===
@app.route('/api/users')
def list_users():
    """pwd.getpwall(), filter uid>=1000, get groups via 'groups' command, sort alpha."""

@app.route('/api/users', methods=['POST'])
def create_user():
    """Accepts {username, password, fullname, confirm_password}.
    Validate: username 3-32 chars, alphanumeric+underscore, re.match(r'^[a-z_][a-z0-9_-]*$').
    password min 4 chars. confirm must match.
    Use sudo adduser + sudo chpasswd (password via stdin, not cmdline).
    Return 201 on success."""

@app.route('/api/users/<username>/permissions')
def get_permissions(username):
    """Return {username, groups, available_groups, memberships:{group:bool}}."""

@app.route('/api/users/<username>/permissions', methods=['POST'])
def set_permissions(username):
    """Accepts {groups:{group:bool}}. sudo groupadd + sudo usermod/sudo gpasswd -d."""

@app.route('/users')
def users_page():
    return render_template('users.html')

@app.route('/users/add')
def users_add_page():
    return render_template('users_add.html')

@app.route('/users/<username>/permissions')
def permissions_page(username):
    return render_template('user_permissions.html', username=username)

# === KIOSK ===
@app.route('/api/kiosk/status')
def kiosk_status():
    """Check systemctl is-enabled kiosk-browser. Return {enabled:bool, browser, display_manager}."""

@app.route('/api/kiosk/toggle', methods=['POST'])
def kiosk_toggle():
    """Accepts {enabled:bool}. Enable/disable kiosk-browser.service + display manager."""

@app.route('/kiosk')
def kiosk_page():
    return render_template('kiosk.html')

# === DASHBOARD ===
@app.route('/api/dashboard')
def dashboard_api():
    """Aggregate {network:{connected,interface,ip}, wifi:{connected,ssid}, users:{count}, kiosk:{enabled}}."""

if __name__ == '__main__':
    import os as _os
    port = int(_os.environ.get('KIOSK_ADMIN_PORT', 5000))
    host = _os.environ.get('KIOSK_ADMIN_HOST', '0.0.0.0')
    app.run(host=host, port=port, debug=True)
```

## ADDITIONAL TEMPLATES REQUIRED

### templates/network.html
- Extends base.html. "Network Status" heading.
- Fetches /api/network/status on load + every 10s.
- Each interface: card with name(bold), type badge, status dot (green/red), IP, MAC.
- Summary: default gateway, DNS. Empty state if no interfaces.
- Vanilla JS fetch(), no framework.

### templates/wifi.html
- "WiFi Configuration" heading. "Scan for Networks" button (≥48px).
- On scan: loading spinner, fetch /api/wifi/scan.
- Results: scrollable cards. SSID(bold), signal bars, lock icon.
- Tap card: expand to show password input + "Connect" button.
- Virtual keyboard on all inputs.

### templates/wired.html
- "Wired Network Configuration" heading.
- Interface dropdown (from /api/network/status, type=wired).
- Mode toggle: DHCP / Static IP buttons.
- Static fields: IP, Netmask, Gateway, DNS.
- Client-side validation. Virtual keyboard on all inputs.

### templates/users.html
- "User Management" heading. "Add User" button.
- Fetches /api/users on load.
- User cards: username, home path, groups as badges.
- "Edit Permissions" button per user.

### templates/users_add.html
- "Create New User" heading.
- Fields: Username, Full Name, Password, Confirm Password.
- Client-side validation: username regex, passwords match.
- Submit POST /api/users. Redirect on success.

### templates/user_permissions.html
- "Permissions for {{username}}" heading.
- Checkbox list of groups. Touch targets ≥48px.
- "Save Permissions" button.

### templates/kiosk.html
- "Kiosk Mode" heading.
- Status card: "Desktop Mode" or "Kiosk Mode".
- Toggle switch with confirmation modal.

### ANTI-PATTERNS (DO NOT DO):
1. DO NOT redefine `app = Flask(__name__)` — use ONE instance for ALL routes.
2. DO NOT put server code (subprocess, pwd, shlex) in JavaScript/templates.
3. DO NOT use render_template_string() — always render_template('file.html').
4. DO NOT skip template files — create the .html file even if simple.
